text: Every subledger eventually has to become a real journal entry in Stonefield Primary Ledger -- Subledger Accounting is the rules engine that makes that translation happen.
The plan names its building blocks: Journal Line Rules, Account Rules, and an Application Accounting Definition that ties them together -- none of them configured yet.
The goal gets written down plainly: every transaction must post to the correct Cost Center, not just the correct account and the correct dollar amount.
Two real sources for Cost Center exist -- the purchase order's requesting business unit, and the invoice distribution's own Cost Center field. Which one gets configured is a decision for later.
Next: planning data migration, security, and the cutover sequence that gets Stonefield ready to go live.
